prep: no prep/ directory for this slug; plan built from notes.json

inherited.M01: Read isolated Japanese words from the ATR word lists (Kuwabara et al. 1989 database lineage); no new production protocol.
inherited.M02: Visual phoneme targets from forced alignment of an audio monophone HMM (HTK), as in the group's Interspeech 2014 lipreading CNN (isca-noda14-cnnlip).
inherited.M03: Per-speaker CNNs and pooled offline training, as in isca-noda14-cnnlip; no adaptation.
inherited.M05: One frontal monochrome camera and one microphone in a laboratory rig, inherited from the group's dataset (Yoshida et al. 2009).
inherited.M07: No language model or grammar reported; isolated-word HMM decoding.
inherited.M08: Isolated word out of a 400-word vocabulary.
inherited.M11: Corpus word labels; HTK forced alignment for phoneme targets.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger names audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) (the 349-study population of M06/avsr-audio-stream-input-representation), classified by whether their full text names a learned denoiser of the audio features (denoising autoencoder or a neural feature/speech enhancement network), any audio enhancement (spectral subtraction, Wiener filtering, speech or feature enhancement, noise reduction, denoising), and MFCC or filterbank features. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); versions count once by key; the target is excluded; dated against the target's first public month 2014-12.
topics.metric: word recognition rate under additive noise (%), higher is better

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept; for this review the same optical-camera lip-reading population is dated against 2014-12 and also counted for CNNs on mouth images and for phoneme or viseme posterior (tandem) features.

The same 349-study AVSR population, classified by the fusion design its full text names: multi-stream or coupled HMMs with stream weights, automatic, adaptive or discriminatively trained stream weights, feature-level concatenation, and deep multimodal (bimodal network) fusion. Boundary: a study counts under every design its text names, related-work mentions included (upper bound); versions count once by key; the target is excluded; dated against 2014-12.
topics.metric: audio-visual word recognition rate under noise (%)
